answer: Each agent must commit a 4 GB proof-of-space plot, and the verifier sends a fresh challenge inside a 90-second window that only the stored data can answer. Two identities sharing one disk would need to reply at the same instant, so a farm must buy and power 4 GB of dedicated storage per fake. Even at the nadir of the epoch, when traffic is thinnest, a garden of identities still needs one sealed plot each, and a pearl-sized commitment hash stops plots being swapped mid-epoch.
